name: Banana Battalion
card_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
card_desc: Battalion was built for players like you. Competitive CT targeting top 100, without the pressure of an elite squad. A solid environment to develop, perform, and progress when you're ready.
modal_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
modal_desc: Banana Battalion takes competition seriously without demanding the same level of commitment as the top teams. It's a good fit for players who are actively improving and want to compete in a structured environment while still having room to develop. The expectation is that you show up, contribute, and keep working to get better.
requirements: Regular participation — expected to contribute meaningfully each event
Open to feedback — willing to learn from more experienced players
Solid scoring — contributing to team placement, not just being present
Active on Discord — keeping up with plans and coordination
Competitive mindset — here to improve, not just to have a team
